pregunta.@en: Cap. 31. What does «읽고 보니 재미있었어요» mean?

texto.@en: When you read it, it was fun.

explicacion.@en: 읽고 보니 = when he read it, it turned out.

texto.@es: Lo leí y no me gustó.
texto.@en: I read it and I didn't like it.

texto.@es: Voy a leerlo y será divertido.
texto.@en: I'll read it and it'll be fun.

pregunta.@en: Cap. 31. It's all over!
Cap. 31. What does «진짜라니까요» mean?

texto.@en: I'm telling you, it's real!

explicacion.@es: 진짜라니까요 = insistir en que es verdad.
explicacion.@en: 진짜라니까요 = insist that it is true.

texto.@es: Es de verdad, eso es todo.
texto.@en: It's real, that's all.
It's a lie.

pregunta.@en: Cap. 32. What does «이사한다면서요?» mean?

texto.@en: Didn't you say you're moving?

explicacion.@en: 이사한다면서요 = didn't you say you're moving?

texto.@en: You moved in yet?
Where are you moving?

pregunta.@en: Cap. 32. If you practice
Cap. 33. What does «도착하는 대로 연락해 주세요» mean?

texto.@en: Let me know as soon as he gets here.

explicacion.@en: 도착하는 대로 = as soon as I get there.

texto.@en: I warned when I got here.

explicacion.@en: That would be 도착했을 때 연락했어요.

texto.@en: He's here unannounced.

explicacion.@en: That would be 연락 없이 도착하세요.

pregunta.@en: Cap. 33. What does «얼마나 좋은지 몰라요» mean?

texto.@es: No te imaginas lo bueno que es.
texto.@en: You can't imagine how good it is.

explicacion.@es: 얼마나 …지 몰라요 enfatiza el grado; no expresa aquí ignorancia literal.
explicacion.@en: 얼마나 - 지 몰라요 emphasizes the degree; it does not express literal ignorance here.

texto.@en: It's good, but not much.

explicacion.@es: Eso sería 좋지만 많이 좋지 않아요.
explicacion.@en: That would be 좋지만 많이 좋지 않아요.

texto.@en: It's very bad.

pregunta.@en: Cap. 33. So much that
Cap. 34. What does «이러다가는 늦겠어요» mean?

texto.@en: If we keep this up, we'll be late.

explicacion.@en: 이러다가는 = if we keep it that way.

texto.@en: We're early.
There's no need to get there.

explicacion.@en: That would be 도착할 필요가 없어요.

pregunta.@es: Cap. 34. ¿Qué significa «맛있을 뿐만 아니라 가격도 싸요»?
pregunta.@en: Cap. 34. What does «맛있을 뿐만 아니라 가격도 싸요» mean?

texto.@es: No solo es rico, también es barato.
texto.@en: It's not only rich, it's cheap, too.
It's rich but expensive.
It's cheap and bad.

pregunta.@en: Cap. 35. What does «늦잠을 자는 바람에 지각했어요» mean?

texto.@en: For falling asleep, I was late.
I slept and got here soon.

explicacion.@en: That would be 자고 일찍 왔어요.

texto.@en: I slept and I wasn't late.

explicacion.@en: That would be 자고 늦지 않았어요.

pregunta.@en: Cap. 35. compared to

pregunta.@es: Cap. 36. ¿Qué significa «날씨가 좋고 해서 공원에 갔어요»?
pregunta.@en: Cap. 36. What does «날씨가 좋고 해서 공원에 갔어요» mean?

texto.@es: Como hacía buen tiempo, fuimos al parque.
texto.@en: As it was a good time ago, we went to the park.

explicacion.@es: 좋고 해서 = como hacía buen tiempo.
explicacion.@en: 좋고 해서 = as it was good weather.

texto.@es: Hacía buen tiempo y no fuimos.
texto.@en: It was a good time, and we didn't go.

explicacion.@en: That would be 좋았는데 안 갔어요.

texto.@en: We'll go if it's been a while.

explicacion.@es: Eso sería 날씨가 좋으면 갈 거예요.
explicacion.@en: That would be 날씨가 좋으면 갈 거예요.

pregunta.@es: Cap. 36. es natural que sea difícil
pregunta.@en: Cap. 36. it is natural that it is difficult

explicacion.@es: 어렵기 마련이에요 = es natural que sea difícil.
explicacion.@en: 어렵기 마련이에요 = it is natural that it is difficult.

pregunta.@en: Cap. 37. What does «가든지 말든지 상관없어요» mean?

texto.@es: Da igual si vamos o no.
texto.@en: It doesn't matter if we go or not.

explicacion.@es: 가든지 말든지 = si vamos o no.
explicacion.@en: 가든지 말든지 = whether or not we are going.

texto.@es: Hay que ir sí o sí.
texto.@en: You have to go yes or yes.
Let's go.

pregunta.@en: Cap. 37. precisely now
Cap. 37. What does «힘들더라도 끝까지 할 거예요» mean?

texto.@es: Aunque sea duro, lo haré hasta el final.
texto.@en: Even if it's hard, I'll do it all the way.

texto.@es: Es duro, así que lo haré.
texto.@en: It's hard, so I will.

explicacion.@en: That would be 힘들어서 할 거예요.

texto.@es: Es duro y no lo haré.
texto.@en: It's hard and I won't.

explicacion.@es: Eso sería 힘들어서 안 할 거예요.
explicacion.@en: That would be 힘들어서 안 할 거예요.

pregunta.@en: Cap. 38. What does «이 답이 맞는지 모르겠어요» mean?

texto.@es: No sé si esta respuesta es correcta.
texto.@en: I don't know if this answer is correct.
This answer is correct.

explicacion.@en: That would be 이 답은 맞아요.

texto.@en: I know it's right.

explicacion.@en: That would be 맞다는 것을 알아요.

pregunta.@en: Cap. 38. Whether to go or not

explicacion.@es: 갈지 말지 = si ir o no.
explicacion.@en: 갈지 말지 = whether or not to go.

pregunta.@en: Cap. 38. What does «사다 주세요» mean?

texto.@en: Buy it and bring it to me, please.

explicacion.@es: 사다 주세요 suele pedir que se compre algo en otro lugar y se traiga a quien habla.
explicacion.@en: 사다 주세요 usually asks you to buy something somewhere else and bring the speaker.

texto.@en: I bought.
I'll buy it.

pregunta.@en: Cap. 39. What does «갔더라면 좋았을 텐데» mean?

texto.@es: Si hubiera ido, habría sido bueno.
texto.@en: If I had gone, it would have been good.
I went and it was good.
I'll go and it'll be good.

explicacion.@en: That would be 가면 좋을 거예요.

pregunta.@es: Cap. 39. parece que va a llover
pregunta.@en: Cap. 39. Looks like it's gonna rain.

explicacion.@es: 올 듯해요 = parece que va a llover.
explicacion.@en: 올 듯해요 = looks like it's gonna rain.

pregunta.@en: Cap. 39. What does «안 왔거든요» mean?

texto.@en: He just didn't come.

explicacion.@es: 안 왔거든요 = es que no vino.
explicacion.@en: 안 왔거든요 = is that he didn't come.

texto.@en: He came in yesterday.
He'll be here tomorrow.

explicacion.@en: That would be 내일 올 거예요.

pregunta.@es: Cap. 40. ¿Qué significa «날씨가 흐렸는데도 많은 사람이 찾아왔어요»?
pregunta.@en: Cap. 40. What does «날씨가 흐렸는데도 많은 사람이 찾아왔어요» mean?

texto.@es: Aunque estaba nublado, vino mucha gente.
texto.@en: Although it was cloudy, a lot of people came.

texto.@es: Como estaba nublado, no vino nadie.
texto.@en: Since it was cloudy, no one came.

explicacion.@es: Eso no lo dice la frase.
explicacion.@en: That's not what the phrase says.

texto.@es: Vino mucha gente porque hacía sol.
texto.@en: A lot of people came because it was sun.

pregunta.@en: Cap. 40. to prepare
Cap. 34. What does «택시를 탈 수밖에 없었어요» express?

texto.@es: No me quedó otra que tomar un taxi.
texto.@en: I had nothing left but a taxi.

explicacion.@es: -(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다 indica que no había otra opción razonable.
explicacion.@en: - (으) - 수밖에 없다 indicates that there was no other reasonable option.

texto.@en: I'd rather take a cab.

explicacion.@es: Preferencia no es el significado de la forma.
explicacion.@en: Preference is not the meaning of the form.

texto.@en: I couldn't take a cab.

explicacion.@es: Eso sería 택시를 탈 수 없었어요.
explicacion.@en: That would be 택시를 탈 수 없었어요.

pregunta.@es: Cap. 36. ¿Qué significa «잘하기는요» como respuesta a un elogio?
pregunta.@en: Cap. 36. What does «잘하기는요» mean in response to a praise?

texto.@es: Qué va, no se me da tan bien.
texto.@en: No, I'm not that good at it.

explicacion.@es: -기는요 rechaza o rebaja modestamente lo que se acaba de decir.
explicacion.@en: -기는요 rejects or minimizes what has just been said.

texto.@en: I'm very good at it.

explicacion.@es: Esa sería una aceptación directa del elogio.
explicacion.@en: That would be a direct acceptance of praise.

texto.@en: I don't want to.

explicacion.@es: No expresa deseo o rechazo de una actividad.
explicacion.@en: It does not express the desire or rejection of an activity.

pregunta.@en: Cap. 38. What does «필요하다고 봐요» express?

texto.@en: I think it's necessary.

explicacion.@es: -다고 보다 presenta una valoración del hablante.
explicacion.@en: -다고 보다 presents an assessment of the speaker.

texto.@en: I was told it was necessary.

explicacion.@es: Eso requeriría una estructura de reporte con fuente ajena.
explicacion.@en: That would require a report structure with a source of others.

texto.@en: If necessary, I'll look at it.

pregunta.@en: Cap. 38. What are you doing?으) «변경되었음을 알려 드립니다»?

texto.@es: Presenta el cambio como un hecho del que se informa.
texto.@en: It presents the change as a fact that is reported.

explicacion.@es: -(으)ㅁ nominaliza la proposición en este aviso conciso.
explicacion.@en: - (으) - Nominates the proposal in this concise notice.

texto.@es: Da una orden de cambiar el programa.
texto.@en: He gives a warrant to change the program.

texto.@es: Indica que el cambio ocurrirá después.
texto.@en: It indicates that the change will happen later.

explicacion.@es: La forma del ejemplo está en pasado.
explicacion.@en: The form of the example is in the past.

pregunta.@es: Cap. 39. ¿Qué función tiene «시간이 있거든 같이 가요»?
pregunta.@en: Cap. 39. What function does «시간이 있거든 같이 가요» have?

texto.@en: If you have time, let's go together.

explicacion.@es: -거든 introduce una condición antes de una sugerencia.
explicacion.@en: -거든 introduces a condition before a suggestion.

texto.@es: Es que tienes tiempo y por eso vamos.
texto.@en: It's just that you have time and that's why we're going.

explicacion.@es: La forma con -거든 al final de la primera cláusula es condicional aquí.
explicacion.@en: The form with -거든 at the end of the first clause is conditional here.

texto.@en: Even if you don't have time, come on.
